milestones.title: Sender-bound remote agent access
milestones.outcome: Add one standards-based remote authorization profile to the existing task and worker boundaries, so possession of a copied token alone cannot read case data or prepare a proposal. Keep tenant, customer, task, policy, approval, lease and stop decisions in the existing server authority.
deliverables: Versioned remote trust-profile contract and compatibility entry distinct from local_opaque_task_grant_not_oauth.
A narrow remote authenticator and resource-server verifier connected to existing task grants, worker leases, current authorization checks and minimized receipts.
Durable replay and restriction/revocation integration, plus a bounded independently implemented client example.
Focused synthetic evidence and a separate deployment-qualification checklist with observed, unobserved and disabled states.
exit_criteria: All five bounded goals have candidate-bound local evidence for their stated behavior and unresolved external prerequisites remain explicit.
The actual remote profile cannot be enabled without verified sender binding, current task authority and shared replay enforcement. A portal is optional and cannot weaken direct-origin checks.
Remote deployment qualification, applicable independent review and inherited formal milestone/release gates remain separate from focused development completion.
No source baseline, accepted-goal ledger or unsupported external-host guarantee is changed by this research proposal.
non_goals: No replacement permission engine, wholesale OAuth server, general orchestration framework, automatic token exchange service or mandatory Cloudflare dependency.
No new business action, remote agent approval authority, approval bypass or enlargement of the current supported commerce envelope.

No full MCP protocol-version migration in this milestone. Start with the existing worker HTTP reads and proposal-preparation contract; expose remote MCP only after its own transport/profile compatibility evidence.
No guarantee about an external agent host's key protection, storage, inference, deletion or network egress merely because Rifare accepts sender proofs.
No claim that DPoP binds a request body or approves its business semantics, and no compliance or Cloudflare certification claim.
milestones.accountable_role: Delegated maintainer for assignment; governing acceptance owner for qualification
milestones.required_demo: Use one synthetic return case: an independent sender-bound client reads facts and prepares a proposal, a copied-token client fails, a two-process proof replay admits at most one request, revocation fences continuation, and the existing operator flow remains available.
milestones.decision_gate: All original and adopted qualification obligations require actual evidence; this plan creates no execution authority.
milestones.release_claim: After local implementation and evidence: a locally verified remote authorization profile for the named read/proposal scope, with deployed issuer and infrastructure qualification reported separately. No production, general OAuth/MCP compatibility, Cloudflare certification or external-agent-host security claim follows from this milestone alone.
local_prerequisites: Bind a separate worker branch and concrete write paths to the newest M08 source checkpoint. This proposal changes neither that source nor its accepted-goal ledger.

Inspect and reuse packages/agent/mcp.mts, the current worker HTTP contract, packages/commerce/work-leases.mts, authorization.mts and kernel.mts. The checkpoint has explicit local opaque grants and bounded worker leases; it does not establish deployed OAuth or sender-bound remote qualification.

Treat milestone dependencies as integration and qualification dependencies. Local contract, fixture and implementation work may proceed under its normal assignment while formal prerequisite acceptance remains open; it must not report those prerequisite milestones as accepted.

Use signed synthetic issuer fixtures, independent local clients and isolated development storage. Select an actively maintained standards library after checking its documented support; do not implement cryptographic primitives or a new general authorization server.

Follow DEVELOPMENT.md and ADR-0032: inspect the affected-file plan, run a coherent focused selection once, and repeat only for a concrete failure or material correction. The default is at most 60 cases in four whole files within one 60-second deadline. Full applicable acceptance evidence belongs to the required integrated gate, not every goal.
qualification_prerequisites: Before enabling a real remote route, identify the actual issuer, client, HTTPS origin, proxy trust configuration, token confirmation mechanism, shared replay store and deployment profile. Confirm that the issuer supports the selected sender-constrained profile; fixture-issued tokens do not qualify a deployed issuer.

Observe the exact deployment with at least two verifier processes or replicas, restart and fail-closed replay-store behavior, revocation and one independently implemented client. Keep tokens, private keys and customer payloads out of retained evidence.
Obtain the existing scoped authorization for connected credentials and effects. A synthetic remote read/proposal exercise does not authorize production data access or financial execution.

Complete applicable existing target-stack, integration-readiness, independent security and formal acceptance obligations separately. Current SQLite diagnostic success cannot establish PostgreSQL, production availability or a fully accepted M07/M08 release.
external_dependencies: A selected OAuth issuer or resource-server integration that supports verifiable sender-constrained access tokens, using RFC 9449 DPoP for the initial profile.
A supported OAuth/JOSE implementation and a shared store capable of atomic replay admission across the deployed verifier replicas.
A controlled HTTPS origin and explicit reverse-proxy trust configuration for live qualification. Cloudflare Access or an MCP portal is optional infrastructure and does not replace origin enforcement.

milestones.title: Managed execution security
milestones.outcome: Qualify one operator-managed runner boundary with mediated network access, constrained resources and a bounded two-branch restriction demonstration, while stating the narrower guarantees available for external agents. Keep AI Gateway use optional.
deliverables: An execution-coverage matrix distinguishing managed runner, trusted broker and external agent responsibilities.
One real isolation profile with a typed broker path, explicit resource budgets and denied direct network/secret access.
Durable task restriction state and a bounded two-branch before-admission enforcement protocol.
A candidate-bound two-branch race/restart demonstration and privacy-minimized enforcement receipts.
An optional gateway policy profile that can remain disabled and unqualified without blocking the core managed execution result.
exit_criteria: The selected real managed-runner profile denies broker bypass and demonstrates the declared resource/secret boundary with candidate-bound local evidence.
The fixed two-branch protected-data workflow fences the removed route before admission, survives the tested restart/failure cases and preserves the named useful operations.
Managed and external-agent coverage is explicit; the result is not generalized to uncontrolled hosts, arbitrary graphs or already completed external effects.
M16-G05 has an explicit optional-gateway state. A disabled or unrequested gateway is a valid core exit with no gateway-qualified claim; enabling it requires its separate profile evidence.

Focused goal checks remain distinct from live infrastructure qualification and applicable integrated acceptance/release reviews. Current target-stack and other qualification blockers retain their original force.
non_goals: No new general agent framework, arbitrary graph scheduler, multi-user shared-memory solution or assurance about an external agent's host network, storage or deletion.
No arbitrary model-generated code execution in this milestone; that remains the conditional M12-G08/M12-G09 work.
No claim that prompt-injection classifiers, model instructions, a tool allowlist or an application exception alone contain hostile execution.
No mandatory Cloudflare runtime, gateway, firewall, billing account or provider. Optional Cloudflare product qualification is separate from the vendor-neutral core.
No cancellation guarantee for an external effect already accepted by its destination; existing operation identity and reconciliation continue to govern uncertainty.
No automatic release approval, certification, weakening of current formal gates or full-regression-per-goal requirement.
milestones.accountable_role: Delegated maintainer for assignment; governing acceptance owner for qualification
milestones.required_demo: In one actual local isolation profile, run two branches over synthetic facts. Admit a protected fact only after the old export path is fenced, show direct egress denied, restart safely and finish an allowed proposal/update. Display external-agent coverage and optional gateway status separately.
milestones.decision_gate: All original and adopted qualification obligations require actual evidence; this plan creates no execution authority.
milestones.release_claim: After successful evidence: one named managed execution profile and one bounded two-branch restriction protocol. Deployment environments, additional platforms or topologies, and optional gateway routes require their own qualification. No control over independently operated external-agent hosts is implied.
local_prerequisites: Read and reuse current runner, model transport, worker lease, authorization, action gateway, privacy and recovery code. The checkpoint's throwing development egress function and request-context guards are not an OS network boundary or hostile-code sandbox.

Assign a separate worker branch and one concrete supported Linux/container isolation profile. Bind proposed broker, isolation and restriction-state changes to actual repository paths before implementation.
Reuse M15's authenticated task identity where the broker is remote. Local isolation and contract work can use synthetic task identities while remote deployment remains unqualified.

Use synthetic protected facts, local recording endpoints and a non-production broker. No real merchant data, paid inference or production business effect is required to develop the core enforcement boundary.

Follow the existing focused-development workflow: at most 60 cases across four whole files and one 60-second deadline by default; one meaningful targeted fault per changed boundary. Broaden only for a concrete uncovered risk or a separately required formal gate.
qualification_prerequisites: To claim managed egress enforcement, observe the exact deployed image/runtime, network and filesystem policy, broker path, task identity and secret placement. An application-level deny function or a mocked container configuration is insufficient.

To claim graph restriction, exercise the supported two-branch topology, actual broker enforcement, stale in-flight work, acknowledgement failure and restart behavior. Do not generalize that result to arbitrary graphs or uncontrolled external runtimes.

Remote broker deployment inherits the relevant M15 live profile qualification. The current diagnostic stack and formal target-stack/security/privacy/recovery release obligations retain their original status.

Any optional Cloudflare gateway deployment requires its own authorized account, gateway, model route, credentials, logging/cache/billing settings and live observations. Core managed-runner completion does not require enabling or qualifying that service.
external_dependencies: One supported OS/container isolation mechanism with enforceable namespace/network policy, bounded resources and a narrow broker channel; ordinary Node process isolation or node:vm alone is not the claimed boundary.
Deployment infrastructure able to run the broker outside the runner's secret and network scope and persist task restriction state with atomic compare-and-update semantics.

Optional only: Cloudflare AI Gateway account and a supported model route, or a different explicitly qualified inference gateway. Cloudflare Dynamic Workers is a possible separate deployment profile, not a required runtime.
Optional gateway/model work must coordinate with the M14 decision-provider integration contract; this milestone owns enforcement configuration and observations, not another decision adapter.

milestones.title: Actual image inference and qualification
milestones.outcome: Add an authorized actual image path and evaluate it under the existing intake, purpose and privacy boundaries.
deliverables: Implement a separately authorized actual image inference path using the existing media access, purpose, transport and decision contracts.
Freeze an authorized image cohort and independent labels before measuring the actual backend, including cannot-assess and context-limit behavior.
Qualify intake, provider retention/deletion, processing and target-host behavior. Audio/video remain disabled unless separately scoped and qualified.
exit_criteria: The default attachment boundary remains restrictive, and every enabled image path has explicit intake, quarantine/processing, exact-case access, provider-purpose, and privacy lifecycle evidence.
Image observations are evidence-linked, bounded, reviewable, and independent of authenticity, eligibility, approval, physical receipt, and financial authority.
Any model-quality claim uses a cohort and gate defined before actual media evaluation; fixture-only implementation status remains distinct from qualification.
Audio/video support is either explicitly disabled/deferred or tied to its own implemented, opted-in, and actually measured profile; an image-only release does not claim all-modality support.
Affected intake/access/privacy/adapter checks and the declared qualification cohort provide candidate-bound evidence without repeating the full product regression suite per goal.
non_goals: No blanket enabling of the existing agent attachment channel or presumption that the current diagnostic upload contract is production-qualified.
No automatic fraud accusation, identity/document authenticity determination, financial entitlement, claim denial, refund approval, or inventory/receipt update based on media scores.
No mandatory Clef-omni account or self-hosted GPU, and no automatic media transfer to an unapproved fallback provider.
No undisclosed recording collection, generative try-on, transcription platform, or new audio/video customer workflow without a declared use case.
No claim that text DLP covers encoded media, that transformed evidence is original evidence, or that logical deletion proves forensic erasure from every external system.

milestones.release_claim: Optional evidence assistance is qualified only for the named media type, purpose, merchant profile, model/backend, and evaluated input limits. It helps operators assess submitted evidence and does not establish authenticity, fraud, entitlement, financial authority, or general multimodal competence.
local_prerequisites: Inspect the current attachment-denying agent boundary and the existing return-intake diagnostic contract before implementation. The contract's restricted PNG/quarantine/sign/content/erase surfaces and model_access=false are reusable foundations, not proof of active qualified model intake.

Keep every existing attachment rejection active until a specifically authorized replacement path passes its intake and privacy checks. Do not assume previously submitted attachments exist or can be reused for inference.
Use licensed/authorized synthetic image fixtures and the current privacy/storage mechanisms for local work; record exact attachment versions and transformations.
Reuse M13/M14's decision contract, bounded evidence, budgets, provider controls, review behavior, and qualification records. Text-routing success does not qualify visual or audio/video handling.
Use focused intake, access, decoder-boundary, privacy, and media-adapter checks during development; evaluate the frozen media cohort at the qualification boundary.
qualification_prerequisites: Before any user media reaches a model, qualify the selected upload types, byte/pixel/decompression bounds, quarantine/processing policy, exact-case access, purpose/provider opt-in, retention, erasure, and derived-record lifecycle.

Freeze the image use case, allowed observations, reference labels, cohort/strata, preprocessing, metrics, targets or threshold-selection rule, and review behavior before evaluating qualification outputs.
Image assistance requires actual model observations on the authorized declared image cohort; fixture media and text-only model quality cannot satisfy that gate.

Audio/video additionally requires a named merchant need, explicit purpose and provider configuration, permitted codecs/duration/size/sampling policy, qualified processing/privacy path, and a separately predeclared measured cohort. Unselected modalities remain disabled.
Cloudflare Gateway text DLP cannot be assumed to inspect encoded image/audio/video content. Any DLP or content-filter coverage must be established for the actual media route.
Evidence-usability or condition classification does not establish authenticity, identity, intent, fraud, warranty entitlement, physical receipt, or financial authority.
external_dependencies: None for isolated synthetic upload/privacy and media-transport development checks.
An approved actual vision/decision backend and authorized labeled image cohort for connected image qualification.

For optional Omni audio/video only: an approved actual multimodal backend, a defined customer use case, authorized recordings, and a qualified codec/processing environment. No new recording capture or external dataset is assumed.

milestones.title: Loyalty attribution and reconciliation gaps
milestones.outcome: Complete attributable awards/reversals, conservative hold resolution and provider balance reconciliation on the landed loyalty foundation.
deliverables: Record provider award and reversal observations tied to original orders and units, including duplicate, reordered and unknown outcomes.
Implement supported multi-unit attribution with bounded provider retrieval before materializing observations.
Retain unsupported store-credit or monetary reward behavior unless its distinct instrument and valuation rules are explicitly scoped and qualified.
Add an authorized administrative resolution for a provably unsent revoked hold whose customer content was minimized before a source binding existed.
Keep uncertain or possibly sent holds conservative and reconcile only against the original operation identity; never release them merely because time elapsed.
Use attributable award/reversal observations and existing redemption records to reconcile the remaining provider balance and linked differences.
Add monetary reward valuation only for explicitly documented supported rules; points remain a separate instrument.

Exercise a complete purchase/redemption/partial-return scenario with duplicate and lost-acknowledgment faults, followed by the independent provider/channel/host qualification described in docs/M19-LOCAL-ASSESSMENT.md.
exit_criteria: The declared provider supports the demonstrated lifecycle with attributable source events and no duplicate accrual, redemption or reversal.
Concurrent redemption, partial return, repeated exchange, timeout and insufficient-balance cases preserve original operation identity and instrument boundaries.
Unsupported partner behavior and incomplete settlement remain visible; loyalty never supplies financial or messaging authority.
The declared loyalty data lifecycle preserves customer erasure after late provider events and restore, with any permitted accounting retention explicitly minimized and recorded.
non_goals: Do not rebuild the existing discount engine, refund ledger or customer-consent system.
No assumed Smile partnership, provider API availability or universal reversal behavior.
No conversion of points into money, debt, a new charge or store credit without a separately qualified instrument and authority.
Loyalty discrepancies cannot silently block an otherwise authorized refund.
No automated outreach justified by another vendor's human P2P service.

milestones.title: Warehouse routes, waves and supplies
milestones.outcome: Use a versioned physical layout and coordinated pick waves to reduce warehouse travel while preserving existing allocations, item identity and inventory conservation; prepare supplies replenishment and optionally execute separately mandated recurring purchases.
deliverables: Versioned warehouse topology and constraint validation.
Explainable route and wave proposals over existing eligible allocations.
Mobile/browser picker, tote and packer handoff coordination.
Consumable usage observations mapped into existing inventory movements.
Threshold/scheduled supplies PO drafts, plus an optional independently gated recurring-purchase mandate using existing procurement and reconciliation services.
exit_criteria: The declared warehouse profile completes a routed wave with current holds, correct item/tote handoffs and no duplicate allocation or stock effects.
Measured routing results identify their baseline and actual observation scope; synthetic travel savings are not merchant productivity claims.

Consumable usage and replenishment drafts reconcile to authoritative stock and existing POs. Recurring purchase remains unavailable unless its separate merchant mandate, supplier qualification, caps, revocation and unknown-outcome gate have actual evidence; default M11 behavior is preserved.
non_goals: Do not rebuild packing sessions, allocation conservation, stock ledgers, transfers or PO approvals.
No claim of globally optimal routes, arbitrary building-plan interpretation or universal scanner support.
No disconnected device may finalize authoritative inventory changes without reconciliation.

No forecast, threshold or skill text authorizes supplier spending. Recurring purchase is a separate explicit merchant mandate with bounded supplier/SKU/quantity/spend terms; it does not weaken M11-G04 proposal-only defaults.
No owned supplies marketplace or guaranteed vendor pricing.
The first local slice may leave recurring purchase unavailable. G05 draft completion cannot be represented as mandate execution qualification or authorize real supplier spending.
